comment: The Phs and Rst jacks are the two inputs the maker never named, so both carry blank tooltips. Two more parameters, X_CV and Y_CV, are configured at SuperLFO.cpp:136-137 with no widget on the panel, so no click reaches them. At the very bottom of its travel the Freq knob sets the rate to exactly zero, SuperLFO.cpp:60-63, which is what makes the Phs jack able to drive the curve on its own. The N1 sum is clamped to 16 although its knob stops at 5, SuperLFO.cpp:191.
